 23class AllyZone(BaseArenaZone):
 24    """Zone designated for allies, dynamically updated based on their position."""
 25
 26    def __init__(
 27        self,
 28        logger: Logger,
 29        point: OrientedPoint,
 30        robot_size: float = 2,  # Assume the robot is a square 2/2 = 1 side length
 31    ) -> None:
 32        """Initializes the AllyZone with position, size, and accessibility.
 33
 34        Args:
 35            logger (Logger): Logger instance for logging messages.
 36            point (OrientedPoint): Position and orientation of the ally.
 37            robot_size (float, optional): Size of the robot. Defaults to 2.
 38        """
 39        position_based_polygon = create_straight_rectangle(
 40            Point(point.x - robot_size, point.y - robot_size),
 41            Point(point.x + robot_size, point.y + robot_size),
 42        )
 43
 44        self.point: OrientedPoint = point
 45        self.robot_size: float = robot_size
 46        super().__init__(
 47            logger=logger,
 48            zone_type=ZoneType.ALLY,
 49            accessibility=ZoneAccessibility.FREE,
 50            buffer_size=0.0,
 51            polygon=position_based_polygon,
 52            buffered_polygon=None,
 53            update_callback=None,
 54            zone_color="#2ea100",
 55        )
 56
 57    @override
 58    def update(
 59        self,
 60        team_color: TeamColor,
 61        ally_position: Point | OrientedPoint,
 62        enemy_position: Point | OrientedPoint,
 63    ) -> None:
 64        """Update the zone based on the positions of allies and enemies.
 65
 66        Args:
 67            team_color (TeamColor, optional): The color of the team.
 68            ally_position (Point | OrientedPoint): Position of ally.
 69            enemy_position (Point | OrientedPoint): Position of enemy.
 70        """
 71        super().update(team_color, ally_position, enemy_position)
 72        self.__init__(
 73            logger=self.logger,
 74            point=(
 75                ally_position
 76                if isinstance(ally_position, OrientedPoint)
 77                else OrientedPoint.from_point(ally_position)
 78            ),
 79            robot_size=self.robot_size,
 80        )
 81
 82    @override
 83    def __eq__(self, other: object) -> bool:
 84        """Return ``True`` if zones represent the same oriented point.
 85
 86        Args:
 87            other (object): Object to compare against.
 88
 89        Returns:
 90            bool: ``True`` if ``other`` is an :class:``AllyZone`` with the same
 91            point.
 92        """
 93        if not isinstance(other, AllyZone):
 94            return False
 95        return self.point == other.point

 99        """Return ``True`` if zones do not represent the same oriented point.

101        Args:
102            other (object): Object to compare against.
103
104        Returns:
105            bool: ``True`` if ``other`` is not an equal :class:``AllyZone``.
106        """
107        return not self.__eq__(other)

111        """Return a hash based on the zone's position and size.

114            int: Hash of the ally zone.
115        """
116        return hash((self.point.x, self.point.y, self.point.theta, self.robot_size))

class BaseArena(abc.ABC): 
 40class BaseArena(ABC):
 41    """Represents the arena and its zones, including buffer areas."""
 42
 43    def __init__(
 44        self,
 45        logger: Logger,
 46        width: int,
 47        height: int,
 48        forbidden_cover_threshold: float,
 49        border_buffer: float,
 50        obstacle_buffer: float,
 51        zones: list[BaseArenaZone],
 52        chunk_size: int = 10,
 53        grid_manager_logger: Logger | None = None,
 54    ) -> None:
 55        """Initializes an instance with dimensions, zones, and configuration parameters.
 56
 57        Args:
 58            logger (Logger): Logger instance for general arena logging.
 59            width (int): Width of the arena in centimeters.
 60            height (int): Height of the arena in centimeters.
 61            forbidden_cover_threshold (float):
 62                Threshold for forbidden cover in the grid.
 63            border_buffer (float): Buffer distance for the arena border.
 64            obstacle_buffer (float): Buffer distance for obstacles.
 65            zones (list[BaseArenaZone]): List of pre-defined zones in the arena.
 66            chunk_size (int, optional):
 67                Size of chunks in the grid manager. Defaults to 10.
 68            grid_manager_logger (Logger | None, optional):
 69                Logger instance for grid manager logging. Defaults to None.
 70        """
 71        # ====== Initialized constructor based attributes ======
 72        # 1. Logger
 73        self.logger: Logger = logger
 74        # 2. Dimensions
 75        self.width: int = width
 76        self.height: int = height
 77
 78        if border_buffer % chunk_size:
 79            self.logger.warning(
 80                "The border buffer is not a multiple of the chunk size -> "
 81                "the not walkable area will not be aligned with the grid",
 82            )
 83
 84        if obstacle_buffer % chunk_size:
 85            self.logger.warning(
 86                "The obstacle buffer is not a multiple of the chunk size -> "
 87                "the not walkable area will not be aligned with the grid",
 88            )
 89        # 3. Buffers
 90        self.border_buffer: float = border_buffer
 91        self.obstacle_buffer: float = obstacle_buffer
 92
 93        # 4. Grid Manager
 94        self.grid_manager: GridManager = GridManager(
 95            logger=grid_manager_logger
 96            or Logger(
 97                identifier="GridManager",
 98                follow_logger_manager_rules=True,
 99            ),
100            chunk_size=chunk_size,
101            width=width,
102            height=height,
103            forbidden_cover_threshold=forbidden_cover_threshold,
104        )
105
106        # 5. Zones
107        self.zones: list[BaseArenaZone] = zones
108
109        # Give to each zone the grid manager to do a callback when they update state
110        for zone in self.zones:
111            zone.update_callback = self._get_grid_manager
112
113        # Add forbidden and border zones to the grid manager
114        for zone in self.zones:
115            if not zone.is_accessible():
116                self.grid_manager.add_forbidden_static_zone(zone.buffered_polygon)
117
118        # ====== Initialized derivative attributes ======
119        # 1. Team color
120        self.team_color: TeamColor = TeamColor.UNDEFINED
121
122        # 2. Additional zones: Border, Ally and Enemy
123        # 2.1 Border zone
124        # We don't need to add the border zone to self.zones, it's a 100% static zone
125        self.border_zone: BorderZone = self.__create_arena_border_zone()
126        self.grid_manager.add_forbidden_static_zone(self.border_zone.buffered_polygon)
127
128        # 2.2 Ally and Enemy zones
129        # Don't need to add these zones to self.zones, they have their own update method
130        # Don't need to add these zones to the grid manager, they are 100% dynamic zones
131        # Don't add them now as dynamic forbidden zones because they are not updated yet
132        #   -> default position for now (wait BaseArena.update method for update)
133        self.ally_zone: AllyZone = AllyZone(
134            logger=Logger(identifier="AllyZone", follow_logger_manager_rules=True),
135            point=OrientedPoint(self.width / 2, self.height / 2, 0),
136            robot_size=1,
137            # The robot is in reality assimilated to a point of null size,
138            # but for the visualisation we need to give it a size
139        )
140
141        self.enemy_zone: EnemyZone = EnemyZone(
142            logger=Logger(identifier="EnemyZone", follow_logger_manager_rules=True),
143            point=OrientedPoint(self.width / 2, self.height / 2, 0),
144            robot_size=15,
145        )
146
147        # 3. Bounding Area and Playable Area
148        # 3.1 Bounding Area: The entire arena (including border buffer)
149        self.bounding_area: Polygon = create_straight_rectangle(
150            Point(0, 0),
151            Point(width, height),
152        )
153
154        # 3.2 Playable Area: The real playable area (excluding border buffer)
155        self.playable_area: Polygon = self.bounding_area.difference(
156            self.border_zone.buffered_polygon,
157        ).buffer(-self.obstacle_buffer)
158
159        # ====== Misc ======
160        self.__prepare_zones()
161
162    # ====== Private Methods ======
163    def __create_arena_border_zone(self) -> BorderZone:
164        """Create a border zone around the arena with a specified buffer width.
165
166        Prevents the robot from approaching too close to the arena edges.
167
168        Returns:
169            BorderZone: A zone representing the arena's border.
170        """
171        arena_polygon = box(0, 0, self.width, self.height)
172        inner_polygon = BaseArenaZone.add_buffer_to_zone(
173            arena_polygon,
174            -self.border_buffer,
175        )
176        border_zone_polygon = cast("Polygon", arena_polygon.difference(inner_polygon))
177
178        return BorderZone(
179            logger=Logger(
180                identifier="BorderZone",
181                follow_logger_manager_rules=True,
182            ),
183            buffer_size=self.border_buffer,
184            buffered_polygon=border_zone_polygon,
185        )
186
187    def __prepare_zones(self) -> None:
188        """Prepare all zones that could be used for calculations.
189
190        It will improve the computing performance.
191        """
192        prepare(self.bounding_area)
193        prepare(self.playable_area)
194        for zone in self.zones:
195            prepare(zone.polygon)
196
197    # ====== Protected Methods ======
198    def _get_grid_manager(self) -> GridManager:
199        """Return the grid manager instance for zone callbacks.
200
201        Returns:
202            GridManager: The current grid manager.
203        """
204        return self.grid_manager
205
206    def _pol_to_abs_cart(self, polars: np.ndarray) -> MultiPoint:
207        """Converts polar coordinates to absolute Cartesian coordinates.
208
209        Args:
210            polars (np.ndarray):
211                Array of polar coordinates in the form of (angle, distance).
212
213        Returns:
214            MultiPoint: Array of absolute Cartesian coordinates.
215        """
216        return MultiPoint(
217            [
218                (
219                    self.ally_zone.point.x
220                    + np.cos(self.ally_zone.point.theta - polars[i, 0]) * polars[i, 1],
221                    self.ally_zone.point.y
222                    + np.sin(self.ally_zone.point.theta - polars[i, 0]) * polars[i, 1],
223                )
224                for i in range(len(polars))
225            ],
226        )
227
228    # ====== Public Methods ======
229    @time_tracker(lambda self: self.logger)
230    def set_team_color(self, team_color: TeamColor) -> None:
231        """Set the team color and trigger updates to zones.
232
233        Args:
234            team_color (TeamColor): The team's color.
235        """
236        if team_color not in {TeamColor.YELLOW, TeamColor.BLUE}:
237            self.logger.error(
238                f"Invalid team color: {team_color}. Must be 'yellow' or 'blue'.",
239            )
240
241        self.team_color: TeamColor = team_color
242        self.update(
243            ally_position=self.ally_zone.point,
244            lidar_scan_polars=np.array([]),
245            optimized_update=False,
246        )  # Force to update all zones
247
248    @time_tracker(lambda self: self.logger)
249    def update(
250        self,
251        ally_position: OrientedPoint,
252        lidar_scan_polars: np.ndarray,  # Polars coordinates issued from the lidar scan
253        *,
254        optimized_update: bool = True,
255        _enemy_position: Point | None = None,  # Only for testing and simulation purpose
256    ) -> None:
257        """Updates the state of the arena, zones, and grid.
258
259        Args:
260            ally_position (OrientedPoint): Current position of the ally robot.
261            lidar_scan_polars (np.ndarray): Lidar scan data in polar coordinates.
262            optimized_update (bool, optional):
263                If ``True``, only updates intersecting zones. Defaults to ``True``.
264            _enemy_position (Point | None, optional):
265                Pre-defined enemy position. Defaults to None.
266        """
267        # 1.Compute enemy position if not directly provided in absolute coordinates
268        if not _enemy_position:
269            # Compute enemy position based on lidar scans -> match situation
270            enemy_position = self.compute_enemy_position(
271                lidar_scan_polars,
272                ally_position,
273            )
274        else:
275            # Use the provided enemy position -> testing or simulation
276            enemy_position = _enemy_position
277
278        # 2.Update ally and enemy zones (specific zone, there are not in self.zones)
279        self.ally_zone.update(self.team_color, ally_position, enemy_position)
280        self.enemy_zone.update(self.team_color, ally_position, enemy_position)
281
282        # 3.Update all other zones
283        # optimized: Update only the zones that intersect with the points
284        all_points: list[OrientedPoint | Point] = [ally_position, enemy_position]
285        for zone in self.zones:
286            if not optimized_update or any(
287                zone.polygon.contains(pt) for pt in all_points
288            ):
289                zone.update(
290                    self.team_color,
291                    ally_position=ally_position,
292                    enemy_position=enemy_position,
293                )
294
295        # 4.Update Grid Manager dynamic forbidden zones (only enemy zone)
296        # self.grid_manager.update_dynamic_forbidden_zones([self.enemy_zone.polygon])
297
298    def compute_enemy_position(
299        self,
300        lidar_scan_polars: np.ndarray,
301        ally_position: OrientedPoint,
302        *,
303        _start_time: int = -1,
304        _numb_enemy: bool = False,
305    ) -> Point | OrientedPoint:
306        """Computes the position of the enemy and updates the arena.
307
308        This function calculates the position of the enemy by processing the
309        lidar scans.
310        It removes any obstacles that are outside the arena, and then determines
311        the closest obstacle as the enemy position.
312        If the enemy position is within a stuff zone, it marks that zone as FORBIDDEN.
313
314        Args:
315            lidar_scan_polars (np.ndarray): Detection points from the LIDAR scan.
316            ally_position (OrientedPoint): Current ally position.
317            _start_time (int, optional):
318                Starting timestamp for the computation. Defaults to -1.
319            _numb_enemy (bool, optional):
320                Whether the enemy is inactive. Defaults to ``False``.
321
322        Returns:
323            Point | OrientedPoint: The computed enemy position.
324        """
325        obstacles: MultiPoint = self.remove_outside(
326            self._pol_to_abs_cart(lidar_scan_polars),
327        )
328
329        if not is_empty(obstacles):
330            return nearest_points(ally_position, obstacles)[1]
331
332        return self.enemy_zone.point
333
334    # ====== Geometry helpers function part ======
335
336    def remove_outside(self, points: MultiPoint) -> MultiPoint:
337        """Remove points that are outside the playable area of the arena.
338
339        Args:
340            points (MultiPoint): Points to check against the playable area.
341
342        Returns:
343            MultiPoint: The points that are within the playable area.
344        """
345        return cast("MultiPoint", self.playable_area.intersection(points))
346
347    def compute_goal_position(
348        self,
349        goal: int | BaseArenaZone | OrientedPoint | Point,
350    ) -> OrientedPoint | Point | None:
351        """Compute a goal position based on zone or point information.
352
353        Args:
354            goal (int | BaseArenaZone | OrientedPoint | Point): Zone identifier
355                or direct destination.
356
357        Returns:
358            OrientedPoint | Point | None: Computed destination or ``None`` if the
359            goal type is invalid.
360        """
361        # 1. If goal is defined as int, it's a zone ID
362        if isinstance(goal, int):
363            if goal > len(self.zones):
364                self.logger.error("Invalid zone ID given in trajectory parameters.")
365                return None
366
367            return self.zones[goal].get_go_to_position(
368                ally_position=self.ally_zone.point,
369                team_color=self.team_color,
370            )
371
372        # 2. If goal is a BaseArenaZone -> compute the best goal point
373        if isinstance(goal, BaseArenaZone):
374            return goal.get_go_to_position(
375                ally_position=self.ally_zone.point,
376                team_color=self.team_color,
377            )
378
379        # 3. If goal is an OrientedPoint or Point, return it as is
380        return goal
381
382    # TODO: Check if this function is still needed, test them (last year code)
383    def valid_position(self, pos: Point) -> bool:
384        """Check if a given position is within the valid playing area.
385
386        Args:
387            pos (Point): The position to check.
388
389        Returns:
390            bool: ``True`` if the position is within the playing area,
391                ``False`` otherwise.
392        """
393        return self.playable_area.contains(pos) or self.playable_area.touches(pos)
394
395    def get_zone_by_location(
396        self,
397        location: int | BaseArenaZone | Point | OrientedPoint,
398    ) -> BaseArenaZone | None:
399        """Find the zone that contains a given location.
400
401        Args:
402            location (int | BaseArenaZone | Point | OrientedPoint):
403                The location to check.
404
405        Returns:
406            BaseArenaZone | None:
407                The zone containing the location, or None if not found.
408        """
409        if isinstance(location, int):
410            if location >= len(self.zones):
411                self.logger.error("Invalid zone ID given in trajectory parameters.")
412                return None
413            return self.zones[location]
414        if isinstance(location, BaseArenaZone):
415            return location
416        for zone in self.zones:
417            if zone.polygon.contains(location):
418                return zone
419        return None
420
421    def find_zone_accessibility(self, accessibility: str) -> list[BaseArenaZone]:
422        """Find and return a list of zones with the specified accessibility.
423
424        Args:
425            accessibility (str): The accessibility level to filter zones by.
426                                 This should be a string representing the name
427                                 of the accessibility level (case insensitive).
428
429        Returns:
430            list[BaseArenaZone]: A list of BaseArenaZone objects that match the
431                                 specified accessibility level.
432        """
433        return [
434            zone
435            for zone in self.zones
436            if zone.accessibility.name == accessibility.upper()
437        ]
438
439    # We check if an element intersects with at least one zone of the specified type
440    def zone_intersects(self, accessibility: str, element: Geometry) -> bool:
441        """Check if a geometric element intersects zones of a given accessibility.
442
443        Args:
444            accessibility (str): Accessibility level to filter zones by.
445            element (Geometry): Geometric element to test for intersection.
446
447        Returns:
448            bool:
449                ``True`` if a matching zone intersects ``element``, ``False`` otherwise.
450
451        Raises:
452            ValueError: If no zones have the specified accessibility.
453        """
454        zones_to_check = self.find_zone_accessibility(accessibility)
455        if not zones_to_check:
456            msg = f"No zones has accessibility: '{accessibility}'."
457            raise ValueError(msg)
458
459        return any(zone.polygon.intersects(element) for zone in zones_to_check)
460
461    def contains(self, element: Geometry) -> bool:
462        """Check if a point is in the arena bounds.
463
464        Args:
465            element (Geometry): The point to check. Points, polygons, etc. are all
466                ``Geometry`` instances.
467
468        Returns:
469            bool: ``True`` if the element is entirely in the arena, ``False`` otherwise.
470        """
471        return self.bounding_area.contains(element)
472
473    # ====== Visualisation part ======
474
475    # ====== Private Methods: draw helpers ======
476    @staticmethod
477    def __plot_oriented_arrow(
478        ax: plt.Axes,
479        point: OrientedPoint,
480        norm: float = 5.0,
481        color: str = "#000000",
482        head_width: float | None = None,
483        head_length: float | None = None,
484    ) -> None:
485        """Draws an arrow from an oriented point with a given direction.
486
487        Args:
488            ax (plt.Axes): Matplotlib axis to draw the arrow on.
489            point (OrientedPoint): Oriented point (x, y, theta) with position and angle.
490            norm (float): Length of the arrow. Defaults to 5.0.
491            color (str): Color of the arrow. Defaults to '#000000'.
492            head_width (float | None): Width of the arrow head.
493                Defaults to None -> norm * 0.2.
494            head_length (float | None): Length of the arrow head.
495                Defaults to None -> norm * 0.3.
496        """
497        if head_width is None:
498            head_width = norm * 0.2
499        if head_length is None:
500            head_length = norm * 0.3
501
502        # Compute the destination point based on the angle and norm
503        dx = norm * np.cos(point.theta)
504        dy = norm * np.sin(point.theta)
505
506        # Draw the arrow
507        ax.arrow(
508            point.x,
509            point.y,
510            dx,
511            dy,
512            head_width=head_width,
513            head_length=head_length,
514            fc=color,
515            ec=color,
516            linewidth=2,
517        )
518
519    @staticmethod
520    def __plot_zone_uid(
521        ax: plt.Axes,
522        zone: BaseArenaZone,
523        color: str = "#000000",
524        fontsize: int = 12,
525    ) -> None:
526        """Draws the zone UID at the center of the zone.
527
528        Args:
529            ax (plt.Axes): Matplotlib axis to draw the UID on.
530            zone (BaseArenaZone): Zone to draw the UID for.
531            color (str, optional): Color of the UID. Defaults to '#000000'.
532            fontsize (int, optional): Font size of the UID. Defaults to 12.
533        """
534        ax.text(
535            zone.polygon.centroid.x,
536            zone.polygon.centroid.y,
537            str(zone.uid),
538            ha="center",
539            va="center",
540            fontsize=fontsize,
541            color=color,
542        )

544    def __get_hatch_parameters(self, zone: BaseArenaZone) -> dict[str, str]:
545        hatch_params = {}
546        if zone.is_accessible(team_color=self.team_color):
547            pass  # No hatch
548        elif zone.is_accessible_for_emergency(team_color=self.team_color):
549            hatch_params = {
550                "hatch": "\\",
551                "hatch_color": "red",
552            }  # Hatch with red lines for restricted zones
553        elif not zone.is_accessible(team_color=self.team_color):
554            hatch_params = {
555                "hatch": "/",
556                "hatch_color": "black",
557            }  # Hatch with black lines for forbidden zones
558
559        return hatch_params
560
561    @staticmethod
562    def __plot_polygon(
563        ax: plt.Axes,
564        polygon: Polygon,
565        color: str,
566        label: str | None = None,
567        alpha: float = 1.0,
568        hatch: str | None = None,
569        hatch_color: str | None = None,
570    ) -> None:
571        r"""Plot a polygon or multipolygon on a matplotlib axis.
572
573        - Fills polygons without holes, optionally with hatching.
574        - Draws only outlines (dashed) for polygons with holes.
575        - Ensures that the same legend label is not added more than once.
576
577        Args:
578            ax (plt.Axes): Axis on which to draw.
579            polygon (Polygon): Polygon to plot.
580            color (str): Fill color of the polygon.
581            label (str | None, optional): Legend label. Defaults to None.
582            alpha (float, optional): Transparency factor. Defaults to 1.0.
583            hatch (str | None, optional): Matplotlib hatching pattern,
584                e.g., ``/`` or ``\\``. Defaults to None for no hatching.
585            hatch_color (str | None, optional): Color of the hatching lines.
586                Defaults to None.
587        """
588        # Avoid duplicate labels
589        existing_labels = ax.get_legend_handles_labels()[1]
590        if label is not None and label in existing_labels:
591            label = None
592
593        if not polygon.interiors:
594            # Polygon without holes
595            x, y = polygon.exterior.xy
596            ax.fill(
597                x,
598                y,
599                alpha=alpha,
600                fc=color,
601                label=label,
602                hatch=hatch,
603                ec=hatch_color or color,
604            )
605        else:
606            # Polygon with holes: outline and interior lines
607            x, y = polygon.exterior.xy
608            ax.plot(x, y, color=color, linestyle="--", label=label, alpha=alpha)
609            for interior in polygon.interiors:
610                x, y = interior.xy
611                ax.plot(x, y, color=color, linestyle="--", alpha=alpha)
612
613    def __plot_zone(
614        self,
615        ax: plt.Axes,
616        zone: BaseArenaZone,
617        *,
618        show_buffer: bool,
619        show_ally_direction: bool,
620        display_zones_go_to_positions: bool,
621        transparency_factor: float = 1.0,
622    ) -> None:
623        """Plot a zone and its buffer on the arena.
624
625        Args:
626            ax (plt.Axes): Axis on which to draw.
627            zone (BaseArenaZone): Zone to display.
628            show_buffer (bool): Whether to plot the buffered polygon.
629            show_ally_direction (bool): Draw an arrow for the ally direction.
630            display_zones_go_to_positions (bool): Draw go-to positions if any.
631            transparency_factor (float, optional):
632                Alpha value multiplier. Defaults to 1.0.
633        """
634        if show_buffer:
635            # Plot buffer zone in transparent color
636            self.__plot_polygon(
637                ax,
638                zone.buffered_polygon,
639                color=zone.zone_color,
640                alpha=0.5 * transparency_factor,
641            )
642
643        if isinstance(zone, BorderZone):
644            self.__plot_polygon(
645                ax,
646                zone.polygon,
647                color=zone.zone_color,
648                alpha=0.5 * transparency_factor,
649            )
650        else:
651            # 1. Define hatch parameters (depends on zone accessibility)
652            hatch_params = self.__get_hatch_parameters(zone)
653
654            # 2. Plot zone uid
655            # Don't plot uid for ally and enemy zones (they increase at each update)
656            if not isinstance(zone, AllyZone) and not isinstance(zone, EnemyZone):
657                self.__plot_zone_uid(ax, zone)
658
659            # 3. Plot the zone polygon
660            self.__plot_polygon(
661                ax,
662                zone.polygon,
663                color=zone.zone_color,
664                label=zone.zone_type.name,
665                alpha=0.8 * transparency_factor,
666                **hatch_params,
667            )
668
669            # 4. Plot go-to positions
670            if display_zones_go_to_positions and zone.go_to_positions:
671                # Get the go-to position nearest to the ally robot
672                nearest_point = zone.get_go_to_position(
673                    ally_position=self.ally_zone.point,
674                    team_color=self.team_color,
675                )
676                for go_to_position in zone.go_to_positions:
677                    # Plot nearest go-to position as green arrow or green dot
678                    if go_to_position == nearest_point:
679                        if isinstance(go_to_position, OrientedPoint):
680                            self.__plot_oriented_arrow(
681                                ax,
682                                go_to_position,
683                                color="green",
684                                norm=5,
685                                head_width=4,
686                                head_length=3,
687                            )
688                        elif isinstance(go_to_position, Point):
689                            ax.plot(go_to_position.x, go_to_position.y, "go")
690                        else:
691                            self.logger.error(
692                                f"Invalid go-to position type: {type(go_to_position)}",
693                            )
694                    else:
695                        ax.plot(go_to_position.x, go_to_position.y, "rx", markersize=5)
696
697            # 5. Plot ally direction
698            if show_ally_direction and isinstance(zone, AllyZone):
699                self.__plot_oriented_arrow(
700                    ax,
701                    zone.point,
702                    color=zone.zone_color,
703                    norm=zone.robot_size + 10,
704                )
705
706    @staticmethod
707    def _init_plot(
708        plot: tuple[plt.Axes, pltFigure] | None,
709    ) -> tuple[plt.Axes, pltFigure]:
710        """Return the axis and figure used for visualization.
711
712        Args:
713            plot (tuple[plt.Axes, pltFigure] | None): Existing axis and figure to
714                reuse.
715
716        Returns:
717            tuple[plt.Axes, pltFigure]: Axis and figure for plotting.
718        """
719        if plot:
720            return plot
721        fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(20, 12))
722        return ax, fig

724    def _plot_zones(
725        self,
726        ax: plt.Axes,
727        *,
728        show_buffer: bool,
729        display_zones_go_to_positions: bool,
730        show_ally_direction: bool,
731        transparency_factor: float,
732        additional_zones: list[BaseArenaZone] | None,
733    ) -> None:
734        """Plot all arena zones and optional extra zones.
735
736        Args:
737            ax (plt.Axes): Axis on which to draw.
738            show_buffer (bool): Whether to display buffer polygons.
739            display_zones_go_to_positions (bool): Draw go-to positions if any.
740            show_ally_direction (bool): Draw an arrow for the ally direction.
741            transparency_factor (float): Alpha multiplier for polygons.
742            additional_zones (list[BaseArenaZone] | None): Extra zones to draw.
743        """
744        self.__plot_zone(
745            ax,
746            self.border_zone,
747            show_buffer=show_buffer,
748            show_ally_direction=False,
749            display_zones_go_to_positions=False,
750            transparency_factor=transparency_factor,
751        )
752        for zone in self.zones:
753            self.__plot_zone(
754                ax,
755                zone,
756                show_buffer=show_buffer,
757                show_ally_direction=False,
758                display_zones_go_to_positions=display_zones_go_to_positions,
759                transparency_factor=transparency_factor,
760            )
761        if additional_zones:
762            for zone in additional_zones:
763                self.__plot_zone(
764                    ax,
765                    zone,
766                    show_buffer=show_buffer,
767                    show_ally_direction=False,
768                    display_zones_go_to_positions=display_zones_go_to_positions,
769                    transparency_factor=transparency_factor,
770                )
771        self.__plot_zone(
772            ax,
773            self.enemy_zone,
774            show_buffer=show_buffer,
775            show_ally_direction=False,
776            display_zones_go_to_positions=False,
777            transparency_factor=transparency_factor,
778        )
779        self.__plot_zone(
780            ax,
781            self.ally_zone,
782            show_buffer=show_buffer,
783            show_ally_direction=show_ally_direction,
784            display_zones_go_to_positions=False,
785            transparency_factor=transparency_factor,
786        )
787
788    def _plot_additional_points(
789        self,
790        ax: plt.Axes,
791        points: list[Point | OrientedPoint] | None,
792    ) -> None:
793        """Plot additional points or oriented points on the arena.
794
795        Args:
796            ax (plt.Axes): Axis on which to draw.
797            points (list[Point | OrientedPoint] | None): Points to display.
798        """
799        if not points:
800            return
801        for p in points:
802            if isinstance(p, OrientedPoint):
803                self.__plot_oriented_arrow(
804                    ax,
805                    p,
806                    color="red",
807                    norm=5,
808                    head_width=4,
809                    head_length=3,
810                )
811            elif isinstance(p, Point):
812                ax.plot(p.x, p.y, "ro")
813            else:
814                self.logger.error(f"Invalid point type: {type(p)}")
815
816    @staticmethod
817    def _plot_trajectory(
818        ax: plt.Axes,
819        trajectory: list[OrientedPoint],
820    ) -> None:
821        """Plot a trajectory connecting oriented points.
822
823        Args:
824            ax (plt.Axes): Axis on which to draw.
825            trajectory (list[OrientedPoint]): Path to draw.
826        """
827        for i in range(len(trajectory) - 1):
828            ax.plot(
829                [trajectory[i].x, trajectory[i + 1].x],
830                [trajectory[i].y, trajectory[i + 1].y],
831                color="purple",
832                linewidth=1,
833                alpha=0.2,
834            )
835
836    def _finalize_plot(self, ax: plt.Axes) -> None:
837        """Finalize axis properties and legend positioning.
838
839        Args:
840            ax (plt.Axes): Axis to configure.
841        """
842        ax.set_xlim(self.width, 0)
843        ax.set_ylim(0, self.height)
844        ax.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
845        ax.spines["right"].set_visible(False)
846        ax.spines["left"].set_position(("axes", 1))
847        ax.yaxis.tick_right()
848        ax.yaxis.set_label_position("right")
849        ax.set_aspect("equal", adjustable="box")
850        ax.set_title("Arena Visualization")
851        plt.legend(loc="center right", bbox_to_anchor=(-0.1, 0.5))
852        plt.tight_layout()
853
854    # ====== Public Methods ======
855    def visualize(
856        self,
857        *,
858        show_buffer: bool = True,
859        trajectory: list[OrientedPoint] | None = None,
860        transparency_factor: float = 1.0,
861        display_zones_go_to_positions: bool = True,
862        show_ally_direction: bool = True,
863        show: bool = True,
864        plot: tuple[plt.Axes, pltFigure] | None = None,
865        additional_zones: list[BaseArenaZone] | None = None,
866        additional_points: list[Point | OrientedPoint] | None = None,
867    ) -> tuple[plt.Axes, pltFigure]:
868        """Visualize the arena and optionally display the plot.
869
870        Args:
871            show_buffer (bool, optional): Whether to display buffered polygons.
872                Defaults to ``True``.
873            trajectory (list[OrientedPoint] | None, optional): Trajectory to draw.
874                Defaults to ``None``.
875            transparency_factor (float, optional): Alpha multiplier. Defaults to 1.0.
876            display_zones_go_to_positions (bool, optional): Plot go-to positions.
877                Defaults to ``True``.
878            show_ally_direction (bool, optional): Draw ally orientation arrow.
879                Defaults to ``True``.
880            show (bool, optional): If ``True``, display the plot immediately.
881                Defaults to ``True``.
882            plot (tuple[plt.Axes, pltFigure] | None, optional):
883                Existing axis and figure. Defaults to ``None``.
884            additional_zones (list[BaseArenaZone] | None, optional):
885                Extra zones to draw. Defaults to ``None``.
886            additional_points (list[Point | OrientedPoint] | None, optional):
887                Extra points to draw. Defaults to ``None``.
888
889        Returns:
890            tuple[plt.Axes, pltFigure]: Axis and figure containing the visualization.
891        """
892        ax, fig = self._init_plot(plot)
893        self.__plot_polygon(ax, self.bounding_area, color="#f0f0f0", label="Arena")
894        self._plot_zones(
895            ax,
896            show_buffer=show_buffer,
897            display_zones_go_to_positions=display_zones_go_to_positions,
898            show_ally_direction=show_ally_direction,
899            transparency_factor=transparency_factor,
900            additional_zones=additional_zones,
901        )
902        self._plot_additional_points(ax, additional_points)
903        if trajectory:
904            self._plot_trajectory(ax, trajectory)
905        self._finalize_plot(ax)
906        if show:
907            plt.show()
908        return ax, fig

Represents the arena and its zones, including buffer areas.

BaseArena( logger: loggerplusplus.logger.Logger, width: int, height: int, forbidden_cover_threshold: float, border_buffer: float, obstacle_buffer: float, zones: list[BaseArenaZone], chunk_size: int = 10, grid_manager_logger: loggerplusplus.logger.Logger | None = None) 
 43    def __init__(
 44        self,
 45        logger: Logger,
 46        width: int,
 47        height: int,
 48        forbidden_cover_threshold: float,
 49        border_buffer: float,
 50        obstacle_buffer: float,
 51        zones: list[BaseArenaZone],
 52        chunk_size: int = 10,
 53        grid_manager_logger: Logger | None = None,
 54    ) -> None:
 55        """Initializes an instance with dimensions, zones, and configuration parameters.
 56
 57        Args:
 58            logger (Logger): Logger instance for general arena logging.
 59            width (int): Width of the arena in centimeters.
 60            height (int): Height of the arena in centimeters.
 61            forbidden_cover_threshold (float):
 62                Threshold for forbidden cover in the grid.
 63            border_buffer (float): Buffer distance for the arena border.
 64            obstacle_buffer (float): Buffer distance for obstacles.
 65            zones (list[BaseArenaZone]): List of pre-defined zones in the arena.
 66            chunk_size (int, optional):
 67                Size of chunks in the grid manager. Defaults to 10.
 68            grid_manager_logger (Logger | None, optional):
 69                Logger instance for grid manager logging. Defaults to None.
 70        """
 71        # ====== Initialized constructor based attributes ======
 72        # 1. Logger
 73        self.logger: Logger = logger
 74        # 2. Dimensions
 75        self.width: int = width
 76        self.height: int = height
 77
 78        if border_buffer % chunk_size:
 79            self.logger.warning(
 80                "The border buffer is not a multiple of the chunk size -> "
 81                "the not walkable area will not be aligned with the grid",
 82            )
 83
 84        if obstacle_buffer % chunk_size:
 85            self.logger.warning(
 86                "The obstacle buffer is not a multiple of the chunk size -> "
 87                "the not walkable area will not be aligned with the grid",
 88            )
 89        # 3. Buffers
 90        self.border_buffer: float = border_buffer
 91        self.obstacle_buffer: float = obstacle_buffer
 92
 93        # 4. Grid Manager
 94        self.grid_manager: GridManager = GridManager(
 95            logger=grid_manager_logger
 96            or Logger(
 97                identifier="GridManager",
 98                follow_logger_manager_rules=True,
 99            ),
100            chunk_size=chunk_size,
101            width=width,
102            height=height,
103            forbidden_cover_threshold=forbidden_cover_threshold,
104        )
105
106        # 5. Zones
107        self.zones: list[BaseArenaZone] = zones
108
109        # Give to each zone the grid manager to do a callback when they update state
110        for zone in self.zones:
111            zone.update_callback = self._get_grid_manager
112
113        # Add forbidden and border zones to the grid manager
114        for zone in self.zones:
115            if not zone.is_accessible():
116                self.grid_manager.add_forbidden_static_zone(zone.buffered_polygon)
117
118        # ====== Initialized derivative attributes ======
119        # 1. Team color
120        self.team_color: TeamColor = TeamColor.UNDEFINED
121
122        # 2. Additional zones: Border, Ally and Enemy
123        # 2.1 Border zone
124        # We don't need to add the border zone to self.zones, it's a 100% static zone
125        self.border_zone: BorderZone = self.__create_arena_border_zone()
126        self.grid_manager.add_forbidden_static_zone(self.border_zone.buffered_polygon)
127
128        # 2.2 Ally and Enemy zones
129        # Don't need to add these zones to self.zones, they have their own update method
130        # Don't need to add these zones to the grid manager, they are 100% dynamic zones
131        # Don't add them now as dynamic forbidden zones because they are not updated yet
132        #   -> default position for now (wait BaseArena.update method for update)
133        self.ally_zone: AllyZone = AllyZone(
134            logger=Logger(identifier="AllyZone", follow_logger_manager_rules=True),
135            point=OrientedPoint(self.width / 2, self.height / 2, 0),
136            robot_size=1,
137            # The robot is in reality assimilated to a point of null size,
138            # but for the visualisation we need to give it a size
139        )
140
141        self.enemy_zone: EnemyZone = EnemyZone(
142            logger=Logger(identifier="EnemyZone", follow_logger_manager_rules=True),
143            point=OrientedPoint(self.width / 2, self.height / 2, 0),
144            robot_size=15,
145        )
146
147        # 3. Bounding Area and Playable Area
148        # 3.1 Bounding Area: The entire arena (including border buffer)
149        self.bounding_area: Polygon = create_straight_rectangle(
150            Point(0, 0),
151            Point(width, height),
152        )
153
154        # 3.2 Playable Area: The real playable area (excluding border buffer)
155        self.playable_area: Polygon = self.bounding_area.difference(
156            self.border_zone.buffered_polygon,
157        ).buffer(-self.obstacle_buffer)
158
159        # ====== Misc ======
160        self.__prepare_zones()

Set the team color and trigger updates to zones.

Args: team_color (TeamColor): The team's color.

@time_tracker(lambda self: self.logger)
def update( self, ally_position: geometry.OrientedPoint, lidar_scan_polars: numpy.ndarray, *, optimized_update: bool = True, _enemy_position: shapely.geometry.point.Point | None = None) -> None: 
248    @time_tracker(lambda self: self.logger)
249    def update(
250        self,
251        ally_position: OrientedPoint,
252        lidar_scan_polars: np.ndarray,  # Polars coordinates issued from the lidar scan
253        *,
254        optimized_update: bool = True,
255        _enemy_position: Point | None = None,  # Only for testing and simulation purpose
256    ) -> None:
257        """Updates the state of the arena, zones, and grid.
258
259        Args:
260            ally_position (OrientedPoint): Current position of the ally robot.
261            lidar_scan_polars (np.ndarray): Lidar scan data in polar coordinates.
262            optimized_update (bool, optional):
263                If ``True``, only updates intersecting zones. Defaults to ``True``.
264            _enemy_position (Point | None, optional):
265                Pre-defined enemy position. Defaults to None.
266        """
267        # 1.Compute enemy position if not directly provided in absolute coordinates
268        if not _enemy_position:
269            # Compute enemy position based on lidar scans -> match situation
270            enemy_position = self.compute_enemy_position(
271                lidar_scan_polars,
272                ally_position,
273            )
274        else:
275            # Use the provided enemy position -> testing or simulation
276            enemy_position = _enemy_position
277
278        # 2.Update ally and enemy zones (specific zone, there are not in self.zones)
279        self.ally_zone.update(self.team_color, ally_position, enemy_position)
280        self.enemy_zone.update(self.team_color, ally_position, enemy_position)
281
282        # 3.Update all other zones
283        # optimized: Update only the zones that intersect with the points
284        all_points: list[OrientedPoint | Point] = [ally_position, enemy_position]
285        for zone in self.zones:
286            if not optimized_update or any(
287                zone.polygon.contains(pt) for pt in all_points
288            ):
289                zone.update(
290                    self.team_color,
291                    ally_position=ally_position,
292                    enemy_position=enemy_position,
293                )
294
295        # 4.Update Grid Manager dynamic forbidden zones (only enemy zone)
296        # self.grid_manager.update_dynamic_forbidden_zones([self.enemy_zone.polygon])

Updates the state of the arena, zones, and grid.

Args: ally_position (OrientedPoint): Current position of the ally robot. lidar_scan_polars (np.ndarray): Lidar scan data in polar coordinates. optimized_update (bool, optional): If True, only updates intersecting zones. Defaults to True. _enemy_position (Point | None, optional): Pre-defined enemy position. Defaults to None.

def compute_enemy_position( self, lidar_scan_polars: numpy.ndarray, ally_position: geometry.OrientedPoint, *, _start_time: int = -1, _numb_enemy: bool = False) -> shapely.geometry.point.Point | geometry.OrientedPoint: 
298    def compute_enemy_position(
299        self,
300        lidar_scan_polars: np.ndarray,
301        ally_position: OrientedPoint,
302        *,
303        _start_time: int = -1,
304        _numb_enemy: bool = False,
305    ) -> Point | OrientedPoint:
306        """Computes the position of the enemy and updates the arena.
307
308        This function calculates the position of the enemy by processing the
309        lidar scans.
310        It removes any obstacles that are outside the arena, and then determines
311        the closest obstacle as the enemy position.
312        If the enemy position is within a stuff zone, it marks that zone as FORBIDDEN.
313
314        Args:
315            lidar_scan_polars (np.ndarray): Detection points from the LIDAR scan.
316            ally_position (OrientedPoint): Current ally position.
317            _start_time (int, optional):
318                Starting timestamp for the computation. Defaults to -1.
319            _numb_enemy (bool, optional):
320                Whether the enemy is inactive. Defaults to ``False``.
321
322        Returns:
323            Point | OrientedPoint: The computed enemy position.
324        """
325        obstacles: MultiPoint = self.remove_outside(
326            self._pol_to_abs_cart(lidar_scan_polars),
327        )
328
329        if not is_empty(obstacles):
330            return nearest_points(ally_position, obstacles)[1]
331
332        return self.enemy_zone.point

Computes the position of the enemy and updates the arena.

This function calculates the position of the enemy by processing the lidar scans. It removes any obstacles that are outside the arena, and then determines the closest obstacle as the enemy position. If the enemy position is within a stuff zone, it marks that zone as FORBIDDEN.

Args: lidar_scan_polars (np.ndarray): Detection points from the LIDAR scan. ally_position (OrientedPoint): Current ally position. _start_time (int, optional): Starting timestamp for the computation. Defaults to -1. _numb_enemy (bool, optional): Whether the enemy is inactive. Defaults to False.

Returns: Point | OrientedPoint: The computed enemy position.

def remove_outside( self, points: shapely.geometry.multipoint.MultiPoint) -> shapely.geometry.multipoint.MultiPoint: 
336    def remove_outside(self, points: MultiPoint) -> MultiPoint:
337        """Remove points that are outside the playable area of the arena.
338
339        Args:

341

def compute_goal_position( self, goal: int | BaseArenaZone | geometry.OrientedPoint | shapely.geometry.point.Point) -> geometry.OrientedPoint | shapely.geometry.point.Point | None: 
347    def compute_goal_position(
348        self,
349        goal: int | BaseArenaZone | OrientedPoint | Point,
350    ) -> OrientedPoint | Point | None:
351        """Compute a goal position based on zone or point information.
352
353        Args:
354            goal (int | BaseArenaZone | OrientedPoint | Point): Zone identifier
355                or direct destination.
356
357        Returns:
358            OrientedPoint | Point | None: Computed destination or ``None`` if the
359            goal type is invalid.
360        """
361        # 1. If goal is defined as int, it's a zone ID
362        if isinstance(goal, int):
363            if goal > len(self.zones):
364                self.logger.error("Invalid zone ID given in trajectory parameters.")
365                return None
366
367            return self.zones[goal].get_go_to_position(
368                ally_position=self.ally_zone.point,
369                team_color=self.team_color,
370            )
371
372        # 2. If goal is a BaseArenaZone -> compute the best goal point
373        if isinstance(goal, BaseArenaZone):
374            return goal.get_go_to_position(
375                ally_position=self.ally_zone.point,
376                team_color=self.team_color,
377            )
378
379        # 3. If goal is an OrientedPoint or Point, return it as is
380        return goal

Returns: OrientedPoint | Point | None: Computed destination or None if the goal type is invalid.

def get_zone_by_location( self, location: int | BaseArenaZone | shapely.geometry.point.Point | geometry.OrientedPoint) -> BaseArenaZone | None: 
395    def get_zone_by_location(
396        self,
397        location: int | BaseArenaZone | Point | OrientedPoint,
398    ) -> BaseArenaZone | None:
399        """Find the zone that contains a given location.
400
401        Args:
402            location (int | BaseArenaZone | Point | OrientedPoint):
403                The location to check.
404
405        Returns:
406            BaseArenaZone | None:
407                The zone containing the location, or None if not found.
408        """
409        if isinstance(location, int):
410            if location >= len(self.zones):
411                self.logger.error("Invalid zone ID given in trajectory parameters.")
412                return None
413            return self.zones[location]
414        if isinstance(location, BaseArenaZone):
415            return location
416        for zone in self.zones:
417            if zone.polygon.contains(location):
418                return zone
419        return None

def find_zone_accessibility( self, accessibility: str) -> list[BaseArenaZone]: 
421    def find_zone_accessibility(self, accessibility: str) -> list[BaseArenaZone]:
422        """Find and return a list of zones with the specified accessibility.
423
424        Args:
425            accessibility (str): The accessibility level to filter zones by.
426                                 This should be a string representing the name
427                                 of the accessibility level (case insensitive).
428
429        Returns:
430            list[BaseArenaZone]: A list of BaseArenaZone objects that match the
431                                 specified accessibility level.
432        """
433        return [

def zone_intersects(self, accessibility: str, element: shapely.lib.Geometry) -> bool: 
440    def zone_intersects(self, accessibility: str, element: Geometry) -> bool:
441        """Check if a geometric element intersects zones of a given accessibility.
442
443        Args:
444            accessibility (str): Accessibility level to filter zones by.
445            element (Geometry): Geometric element to test for intersection.
446
447        Returns:
448            bool:
449                ``True`` if a matching zone intersects ``element``, ``False`` otherwise.
450
451        Raises:
452            ValueError: If no zones have the specified accessibility.
453        """
454        zones_to_check = self.find_zone_accessibility(accessibility)
455        if not zones_to_check:
456            msg = f"No zones has accessibility: '{accessibility}'."
457            raise ValueError(msg)
458
459        return any(zone.polygon.intersects(element) for zone in zones_to_check)

Check if a geometric element intersects zones of a given accessibility.

Returns: bool: True if a matching zone intersects element, False otherwise.

Raises: ValueError: If no zones have the specified accessibility.

855    def visualize(
856        self,
857        *,
858        show_buffer: bool = True,
859        trajectory: list[OrientedPoint] | None = None,
860        transparency_factor: float = 1.0,
861        display_zones_go_to_positions: bool = True,
862        show_ally_direction: bool = True,
863        show: bool = True,
864        plot: tuple[plt.Axes, pltFigure] | None = None,
865        additional_zones: list[BaseArenaZone] | None = None,
866        additional_points: list[Point | OrientedPoint] | None = None,
867    ) -> tuple[plt.Axes, pltFigure]:
868        """Visualize the arena and optionally display the plot.
869
870        Args:
871            show_buffer (bool, optional): Whether to display buffered polygons.
872                Defaults to ``True``.

877                Defaults to ``True``.
878            show_ally_direction (bool, optional): Draw ally orientation arrow.
879                Defaults to ``True``.
880            show (bool, optional): If ``True``, display the plot immediately.
881                Defaults to ``True``.

883                Existing axis and figure. Defaults to ``None``.
884            additional_zones (list[BaseArenaZone] | None, optional):
885                Extra zones to draw. Defaults to ``None``.
886            additional_points (list[Point | OrientedPoint] | None, optional):
887                Extra points to draw. Defaults to ``None``.
888
889        Returns:
890            tuple[plt.Axes, pltFigure]: Axis and figure containing the visualization.
891        """
892        ax, fig = self._init_plot(plot)
893        self.__plot_polygon(ax, self.bounding_area, color="#f0f0f0", label="Arena")
894        self._plot_zones(
895            ax,
896            show_buffer=show_buffer,
897            display_zones_go_to_positions=display_zones_go_to_positions,
898            show_ally_direction=show_ally_direction,
899            transparency_factor=transparency_factor,
900            additional_zones=additional_zones,
901        )
902        self._plot_additional_points(ax, additional_points)
903        if trajectory:
904            self._plot_trajectory(ax, trajectory)
905        self._finalize_plot(ax)
906        if show:
907            plt.show()
908        return ax, fig

class BaseArenaZone(abc.ABC): 
 26class BaseArenaZone(ABC):
 27    """Represent a zone within an arena with geometry, type, and accessibility.
 28
 29    Attributes:
 30        zones_uid (ClassVar[list[int]]): Sequence of used identifiers for zones.
 31    """
 32
 33    zones_uid: ClassVar[list[int]] = []
 34
 35    def __init__(
 36        self,
 37        logger: Logger,
 38        zone_type: ZoneType,
 39        accessibility: ZoneAccessibility,
 40        buffer_size: float = 0.0,
 41        polygon: Polygon | None = None,
 42        buffered_polygon: Polygon | None = None,
 43        update_callback: Callable | None = None,
 44        zone_color: str = "#9e9e9e",
 45        go_to_positions: list[OrientedPoint | Point] | None = None,
 46        uid: int | None = None,
 47    ) -> None:
 48        """Initialize the zone with geometry, type, color, and accessibility.
 49
 50        Args:
 51            logger (Logger): Logger instance for logging messages.
 52            zone_type (ZoneType): Category of the zone.
 53            accessibility (ZoneAccessibility): Accessibility of the zone.
 54            buffer_size (float, optional):
 55                Buffer size for geometric adjustments. Defaults to 0.0.
 56            polygon (Polygon | None, optional):
 57                Polygon representing the zone geometry. Defaults to None.
 58            buffered_polygon (Polygon | None, optional):
 59                Buffered polygon geometry. Defaults to None.
 60            update_callback (Callable | None, optional):
 61                Function called on updates. Defaults to None.
 62            zone_color (str, optional):
 63                Color associated with the zone. Defaults to "#9e9e9e".
 64            go_to_positions (list[OrientedPoint | Point] | None, optional):
 65                List of go-to positions within the zone. Defaults to None.
 66            uid (int | None, optional):
 67                Unique identifier for the zone instance. Defaults to None.
 68        """
 69        self.logger: Logger = logger
 70        self.zone_type: ZoneType = zone_type
 71        self.accessibility: ZoneAccessibility = accessibility
 72
 73        if polygon is None and buffered_polygon is None:
 74            self.logger.error("No polygon provided for zone")
 75        elif polygon is not None and buffered_polygon is None:
 76            buffered_polygon = self.add_buffer_to_zone(polygon, buffer_size)
 77        elif polygon is None and buffered_polygon is not None:
 78            polygon = self.add_buffer_to_zone(buffered_polygon, -buffer_size)
 79
 80        self.buffer_size: float = buffer_size
 81        self.polygon: Polygon = polygon
 82        self.buffered_polygon: Polygon = buffered_polygon
 83
 84        self.update_callback = update_callback
 85        self.go_to_positions = go_to_positions
 86
 87        self.zone_color: str = zone_color
 88        self.enemy_visits: int = 0
 89        self.ally_visits: int = 0
 90        self.last_update_time: float = 0.0
 91
 92        self.uid = BaseArenaZone.get_new_uid(uid)
 93
 94    @classmethod
 95    def get_new_uid(cls, input_uid: int | None) -> int:
 96        """Return a unique identifier for a zone.
 97
 98        Args:
 99            input_uid (int | None): Requested identifier. Defaults to None.
100
101        Returns:
102            int: Newly generated identifier.
103        """
104        if input_uid is not None:
105            cls.zones_uid.append(input_uid)
106            return input_uid
107
108        if cls.zones_uid:
109            cls.zones_uid.append(cls.zones_uid[-1] + 1)
110        else:
111            cls.zones_uid.append(0)
112        return cls.zones_uid[-1]
113
114    @staticmethod
115    def add_buffer_to_zone(polygon: Polygon, buffer: float) -> Polygon:
116        """Add a buffer around a zone.
117
118        The buffer uses a square cap style to match the grid structure.
119
120        Args:
121            polygon (Polygon): Polygon to buffer.
122            buffer (float): Buffer size to apply.
123
124        Returns:
125            Polygon: Buffered polygon.
126        """
127        return polygon.buffer(
128            buffer,
129            cap_style=BufferCapStyle.flat,
130            join_style=BufferJoinStyle.mitre,
131        )
132
133    # ====== Accessibility methods ======
134
135    def is_accessible(
136        self,
137        team_color: TeamColor = TeamColor.UNDEFINED,  # noqa:ARG002
138    ) -> bool:
139        """Determine if the zone is accessible for a given team color.
140
141        Args:
142            team_color (TeamColor, optional):
143                Color of the team. Defaults to TeamColor.UNDEFINED.
144
145        Returns:
146            bool: ``True`` if accessible, ``False`` otherwise.
147        """
148        return self.accessibility not in {
149            ZoneAccessibility.FORBIDDEN,
150            ZoneAccessibility.RESTRICTED,
151        }
152
153    def is_accessible_for_emergency(
154        self,
155        team_color: TeamColor = TeamColor.UNDEFINED,  # noqa: ARG002
156    ) -> bool:
157        """Determine if the zone is accessible in an emergency.
158
159        Args:
160            team_color (TeamColor, optional): Color of the team.
161                Defaults to TeamColor.UNDEFINED.
162
163        Returns:
164            bool: ``True`` if accessible in emergencies, ``False`` otherwise.
165        """
166        return self.accessibility != ZoneAccessibility.FORBIDDEN
167
168    def get_go_to_position(
169        self,
170        ally_position: OrientedPoint,
171        team_color: TeamColor,
172    ) -> OrientedPoint | Point | None:
173        """Determine the best go-to position for an ally in the given zone.
174
175        Args:
176            ally_position (OrientedPoint): Position of the ally.
177            team_color (TeamColor): Color of the team.
178
179        Returns:
180            OrientedPoint | Point | None:
181                Best go-to position, or ``None`` if inaccessible.
182        """
183        if not self.is_accessible(team_color):
184            self.logger.debug(
185                f"GoTo position request: Zone {self.zone_type} is not accessible.",
186            )
187            return None
188
189        # If no specific go-to positions are defined, return the centroid of the zone
190        if not self.go_to_positions:
191            self.logger.debug(
192                "GoTo position request: "
193                f"No defined go-to positions for zone {self.zone_type}, "
194                f"returning centroid [{self.polygon.centroid}]",
195            )
196            return self.polygon.centroid
197
198        nearest_position = min(
199            self.go_to_positions,
200            key=ally_position.distance,
201        )
202        msg = (
203            "GoTo position request: Nearest go-to position to ally "
204            f"[{ally_position}] is [{nearest_position}]"
205        )
206        self.logger.debug(msg)
207
208        return nearest_position
209
210    # ====== Update methods ======
211
212    def update(
213        self,
214        team_color: TeamColor,  # noqa:ARG002
215        ally_position: Point | OrientedPoint,
216        enemy_position: Point | OrientedPoint,
217    ) -> None:
218        """Update the zone based on the positions of allies and enemies.
219
220        Args:
221            team_color (TeamColor): Color of the team.
222            ally_position (Point | OrientedPoint): Position of the ally.
223            enemy_position (Point | OrientedPoint): Position of the enemy.
224        """
225        # Update visit counts
226        if self.polygon.contains(enemy_position):  # Don't consider the buffer
227            self.enemy_visits += 1
228            self.logger.debug(f"Enemy visited {self.zone_type} zone")
229
230        if self.polygon.contains(ally_position):  # Don't consider the buffer
231            self.ally_visits += 1
232            self.logger.debug(f"Ally visited {self.zone_type} zone")
233
234        self.last_update_time = Utils.get_ts()
235
236    def _make_accessible(self) -> None:
237        """Mark the zone as accessible and update the grid manager."""
238        self.accessibility = ZoneAccessibility.FREE
239        grid_manager: GridManager = self.update_callback()
240        grid_manager.remove_forbidden_static_zone(self.buffered_polygon)
241        self.logger.debug(f"{self.zone_type} zone is now accessible")
242
243    # ====== Built-in methods ======
244
245    def __instancecheck__(self, other: object) -> bool:
246        """Return ``True`` if ``other`` is an instance of the same class.
247
248        Args:
249            other (object): Object to compare against.
250
251        Returns:
252            bool: ``True`` if ``other`` shares this class type.
253        """
254        return type(self) is type(other) and (
255            isinstance(self, type(other)) or isinstance(other, type(self))
256        )
257
258    @override
259    def __eq__(self, other: object) -> bool:
260        """Return ``True`` if ``other`` has the same geometry and accessibility.
261
262        Args:
263            other (object): Object to compare against.
264
265        Returns:
266            bool: ``True`` if polygons and accessibility match.
267        """
268        if not isinstance(self, type(other)):
269            return False
270        return (
271            self.polygon == getattr(other, "polygon", None)
272            and self.buffered_polygon == getattr(other, "buffered_polygon", None)
273            and self.accessibility == getattr(other, "accessibility", None)
274        )
275
276    @override
277    def __ne__(self, other: object) -> bool:
278        """Return ``True`` if ``other`` differs in geometry or accessibility.
279
280        Args:
281            other (object): Object to compare against.
282
283        Returns:
284            bool: ``True`` if zones are not equal.
285        """
286        return not self.__eq__(other)
287
288    @override
289    def __str__(self) -> str:
290        """Return a concise string representation of the zone.
291
292        Returns:
293            str: Human-readable information about the zone.
294        """
295        return (
296            f"{self.zone_type}: {self.buffered_polygon.centroid} -> "
297            f"{self.accessibility}, ally visits: {self.ally_visits}, "
298            f"enemy visits: {self.enemy_visits}, last update: {self.last_update_time}, "
299            f"go-to positions: {self.go_to_positions}"
300        )
301
302    @override
303    def __repr__(self) -> str:
304        """Return the official string representation of the zone.
305
306        Returns:
307            str: Formal representation of the zone.
308        """
309        return self.__str__()
310
311    @override
312    def __hash__(self) -> int:
313        """Return a hash based on the zone unique identifier.
314
315        Returns:
316            int: Hash value for the zone.
317        """
318        return hash(self.uid)
319
320    @override
321    def __format__(self, _format_spec: str) -> str:
322        """Format the zone as a string.
323
324        Args:
325            _format_spec (str): Formatting specification.
326
327        Returns:
328            str: Formatted representation.
329        """
330        return self.__str__()

40        buffer_size: float = 0.0,
41        polygon: Polygon | None = None,
42        buffered_polygon: Polygon | None = None,
43        update_callback: Callable | None = None,
44        zone_color: str = "#9e9e9e",
45        go_to_positions: list[OrientedPoint | Point] | None = None,
46        uid: int | None = None,
47    ) -> None:
48        """Initialize the zone with geometry, type, color, and accessibility.
49
50        Args:
51            logger (Logger): Logger instance for logging messages.
52            zone_type (ZoneType): Category of the zone.
53            accessibility (ZoneAccessibility): Accessibility of the zone.
54            buffer_size (float, optional):
55                Buffer size for geometric adjustments. Defaults to 0.0.
56            polygon (Polygon | None, optional):
57                Polygon representing the zone geometry. Defaults to None.
58            buffered_polygon (Polygon | None, optional):
59                Buffered polygon geometry. Defaults to None.
60            update_callback (Callable | None, optional):
61                Function called on updates. Defaults to None.
62            zone_color (str, optional):
63                Color associated with the zone. Defaults to "#9e9e9e".
64            go_to_positions (list[OrientedPoint | Point] | None, optional):
65                List of go-to positions within the zone. Defaults to None.
66            uid (int | None, optional):
67                Unique identifier for the zone instance. Defaults to None.
68        """
69        self.logger: Logger = logger
70        self.zone_type: ZoneType = zone_type
71        self.accessibility: ZoneAccessibility = accessibility
72
73        if polygon is None and buffered_polygon is None:
74            self.logger.error("No polygon provided for zone")
75        elif polygon is not None and buffered_polygon is None:
76            buffered_polygon = self.add_buffer_to_zone(polygon, buffer_size)
77        elif polygon is None and buffered_polygon is not None:
78            polygon = self.add_buffer_to_zone(buffered_polygon, -buffer_size)
79
80        self.buffer_size: float = buffer_size
81        self.polygon: Polygon = polygon
82        self.buffered_polygon: Polygon = buffered_polygon
83
84        self.update_callback = update_callback
85        self.go_to_positions = go_to_positions
86
87        self.zone_color: str = zone_color
88        self.enemy_visits: int = 0
89        self.ally_visits: int = 0
90        self.last_update_time: float = 0.0
91
92        self.uid = BaseArenaZone.get_new_uid(uid)

@classmethod
def get_new_uid(cls, input_uid: int | None) -> int: 
 94    @classmethod
 95    def get_new_uid(cls, input_uid: int | None) -> int:
 96        """Return a unique identifier for a zone.
 97
 98        Args:
 99            input_uid (int | None): Requested identifier. Defaults to None.
100
101        Returns:
102            int: Newly generated identifier.
103        """
104        if input_uid is not None:
105            cls.zones_uid.append(input_uid)
106            return input_uid
107
108        if cls.zones_uid:
109            cls.zones_uid.append(cls.zones_uid[-1] + 1)
110        else:
111            cls.zones_uid.append(0)
112        return cls.zones_uid[-1]

@staticmethod
def add_buffer_to_zone( polygon: shapely.geometry.polygon.Polygon, buffer: float) -> shapely.geometry.polygon.Polygon: 
114    @staticmethod
115    def add_buffer_to_zone(polygon: Polygon, buffer: float) -> Polygon:
116        """Add a buffer around a zone.
117
118        The buffer uses a square cap style to match the grid structure.
119
120        Args:
121            polygon (Polygon): Polygon to buffer.
122            buffer (float): Buffer size to apply.
123
124        Returns:
125            Polygon: Buffered polygon.
126        """
127        return polygon.buffer(
128            buffer,
129            cap_style=BufferCapStyle.flat,
130            join_style=BufferJoinStyle.mitre,
131        )

def get_go_to_position( self, ally_position: geometry.OrientedPoint, team_color: TeamColor) -> geometry.OrientedPoint | shapely.geometry.point.Point | None: 
168    def get_go_to_position(
169        self,
170        ally_position: OrientedPoint,
171        team_color: TeamColor,
172    ) -> OrientedPoint | Point | None:
173        """Determine the best go-to position for an ally in the given zone.
174
175        Args:
176            ally_position (OrientedPoint): Position of the ally.
177            team_color (TeamColor): Color of the team.
178
179        Returns:
180            OrientedPoint | Point | None:
181                Best go-to position, or ``None`` if inaccessible.
182        """
183        if not self.is_accessible(team_color):
184            self.logger.debug(
185                f"GoTo position request: Zone {self.zone_type} is not accessible.",
186            )
187            return None
188
189        # If no specific go-to positions are defined, return the centroid of the zone
190        if not self.go_to_positions:
191            self.logger.debug(
192                "GoTo position request: "
193                f"No defined go-to positions for zone {self.zone_type}, "
194                f"returning centroid [{self.polygon.centroid}]",
195            )
196            return self.polygon.centroid
197
198        nearest_position = min(
199            self.go_to_positions,
200            key=ally_position.distance,
201        )
202        msg = (
203            "GoTo position request: Nearest go-to position to ally "
204            f"[{ally_position}] is [{nearest_position}]"
205        )
206        self.logger.debug(msg)
207
208        return nearest_position

Determine the best go-to position for an ally in the given zone.

Args: ally_position (OrientedPoint): Position of the ally. team_color (TeamColor): Color of the team.

Returns: OrientedPoint | Point | None: Best go-to position, or None if inaccessible.

def update( self, team_color: TeamColor, ally_position: shapely.geometry.point.Point | geometry.OrientedPoint, enemy_position: shapely.geometry.point.Point | geometry.OrientedPoint) -> None: 
212    def update(
213        self,
214        team_color: TeamColor,  # noqa:ARG002
215        ally_position: Point | OrientedPoint,
216        enemy_position: Point | OrientedPoint,
217    ) -> None:
218        """Update the zone based on the positions of allies and enemies.
219
220        Args:
221            team_color (TeamColor): Color of the team.
222            ally_position (Point | OrientedPoint): Position of the ally.
223            enemy_position (Point | OrientedPoint): Position of the enemy.
224        """
225        # Update visit counts
226        if self.polygon.contains(enemy_position):  # Don't consider the buffer
227            self.enemy_visits += 1
228            self.logger.debug(f"Enemy visited {self.zone_type} zone")
229
230        if self.polygon.contains(ally_position):  # Don't consider the buffer
231            self.ally_visits += 1
232            self.logger.debug(f"Ally visited {self.zone_type} zone")
233
234        self.last_update_time = Utils.get_ts()

Update the zone based on the positions of allies and enemies.

Args: team_color (TeamColor): Color of the team. ally_position (Point | OrientedPoint): Position of the ally. enemy_position (Point | OrientedPoint): Position of the enemy.
