class GridManager: 
 23class GridManager:
 24    """Manages a grid for pathfinding and collision detection.
 25
 26    Includes static and dynamic forbidden zones and grid visualization.
 27
 28    - The grid uses a coordinate system where the origin is in the
 29      bottom-right corner.
 30    - X-axis increases towards the left, while Y-axis increases upwards.
 31    - This reference frame affects calculations and visualization;
 32      adjustments ensure alignment.
 33    """
 34
 35    def __init__(
 36        self,
 37        logger: Logger,
 38        chunk_size: int,
 39        width: int,
 40        height: int,
 41        forbidden_cover_threshold: float = 0.5,
 42    ) -> None:
 43        """Initializes the grid manager.
 44
 45        Args:
 46            logger (Logger): Logger instance for logging errors and information.
 47            chunk_size (int): Size of each grid chunk.
 48            width (int): Total width of the grid in absolute units.
 49            height (int): Total height of the grid in absolute units.
 50            forbidden_cover_threshold (float, optional): Minimum coverage ratio
 51                for a cell to be marked as forbidden. Defaults to 0.5.
 52        """
 53        self.logger: Logger = logger
 54        self.forbidden_cover_threshold: float = forbidden_cover_threshold
 55
 56        # Validate chunk size
 57        if width % chunk_size or height % chunk_size:
 58            self.logger.log(
 59                "[GRID] width and height must be multiples of chunk_size. "
 60                "Chunk size will be adjusted to the nearest multiple.",
 61                LogLevels.ERROR,
 62            )
 63            chunk_size = min(width, height, key=lambda x: abs(x - chunk_size))
 64
 65        self.chunk_size: int = chunk_size
 66        self.half_chunk_size: float = chunk_size / 2
 67        self.absolute_width: int = width
 68        self.absolute_height: int = height
 69        self.grid_width: int = width // chunk_size
 70        self.grid_height: int = height // chunk_size
 71
 72        self.static_forbidden_zones: list[Polygon] = []
 73
 74        self.not_updated_forbidden_zones: list[Polygon] = []
 75
 76        self.static_grid: Grid = self.__generate_base_grid()
 77        self.static_and_dynamic_grid: Grid = self.__generate_base_grid()
 78
 79    # ====== Private Methods ======
 80
 81    def __generate_base_grid(self) -> Grid:
 82        """Generate a base grid with all cells walkable.
 83
 84        Returns:
 85            Grid: Newly created walkable grid.
 86        """
 87        return Grid(
 88            matrix=[
 89                [1 for _ in range(self.grid_width)] for _ in range(self.grid_height)
 90            ],
 91        )
 92
 93    @time_tracker(lambda self: self.logger)
 94    def __mark_zone(
 95        self,
 96        grid: Grid,
 97        polygon_to_mark: Polygon,
 98        *,
 99        walkable: bool,
100    ) -> Grid:
101        grid = copy.deepcopy(grid)
102        minx, miny, maxx, maxy = polygon_to_mark.bounds
103
104        min_col, max_col = (
105            int((self.absolute_width - maxx) // self.chunk_size),
106            int((self.absolute_width - minx) // self.chunk_size),
107        )
108        min_row, max_row = int(miny // self.chunk_size), int(maxy // self.chunk_size)
109
110        for row in range(max(min_row, 0), min(max_row + 1, self.grid_height)):
111            for col in range(max(min_col, 0), min(max_col + 1, self.grid_width)):
112                actual_col = self.grid_width - 1 - col
113                cell = box(
114                    (self.grid_width - 1 - col) * self.chunk_size,
115                    row * self.chunk_size,
116                    (self.grid_width - col) * self.chunk_size,
117                    (row + 1) * self.chunk_size,
118                )
119
120                if polygon_to_mark.intersects(cell):
121                    if walkable:
122                        if any(
123                            polygon.intersects(cell)
124                            for polygon in self.static_forbidden_zones
125                        ):
126                            continue
127
128                        grid.nodes[row][actual_col].walkable = walkable
129
130                    if (
131                        not walkable
132                        and polygon_to_mark.intersection(cell).area / cell.area
133                        >= self.forbidden_cover_threshold
134                    ):
135                        grid.nodes[row][actual_col].walkable = walkable
136
137        return grid
138
139    @time_tracker(lambda self: self.logger)
140    def __optimized_mark_zone(  # QUESTION: Useless ?
141        self,
142        grid: Grid,
143        polygon_to_mark: Polygon,
144        *,
145        walkable: bool,
146    ) -> Grid:
147        """Marks cells in the grid as forbidden based on intersection with a polygon.
148
149        Args:
150            grid (Grid): The grid to modify.
151            polygon_to_mark (Polygon): The polygon defining forbidden zones.
152            walkable (bool): Whether the cells should be marked as walkable.
153
154        Returns:
155            Grid: Updated grid with forbidden zones marked.
156        """
157        # Precompute polygon bounds and indices
158        minx, miny, maxx, maxy = polygon_to_mark.bounds
159
160        min_col = max(
161            0,
162            int((self.grid_width * self.chunk_size - maxx) // self.chunk_size),
163        )
164        max_col = min(
165            self.grid_width,
166            int((self.grid_width * self.chunk_size - minx) // self.chunk_size) + 1,
167        )
168        min_row = max(0, int(miny // self.chunk_size))
169        max_row = min(self.grid_height, int(maxy // self.chunk_size) + 1)
170
171        # Build STRtree with geometries
172        if walkable and self.static_forbidden_zones:
173            static_zone_tree = STRtree(self.static_forbidden_zones)
174
175        # Iterate over relevant grid cells
176        for row in range(min_row, max_row):
177            for col in range(min_col, max_col):
178                actual_col = self.grid_width - 1 - col
179                cell: Polygon = box(
180                    actual_col * self.chunk_size,
181                    row * self.chunk_size,
182                    (actual_col + 1) * self.chunk_size,
183                    (row + 1) * self.chunk_size,
184                )
185
186                # Check if the polygon intersects the grid cell
187                if polygon_to_mark.intersects(cell):
188                    # Check static forbidden zones if walkable
189                    if walkable and self.static_forbidden_zones:
190                        overlapping_zones: np.ndarray[Any, np.dtype[np.intp]] = (
191                            static_zone_tree.query(cell)
192                        )
193                        # Cast the ndarray to a list of Polygons
194                        overlapping_polygons = [
195                            self.static_forbidden_zones[i] for i in overlapping_zones
196                        ]
197                        if any(zone.intersects(cell) for zone in overlapping_polygons):
198                            continue
199
200                    # Update cell walkable status
201                    grid.nodes[row][actual_col].walkable = walkable
202
203        return grid
204
205    @time_tracker(lambda self: self.logger)
206    def __update_grid(
207        self,
208        *,
209        update_static_zones: bool = False,
210        update_dynamic_zones: bool = False,
211        clear_grid: bool = False,
212    ) -> None:
213        """Update the grids for static and dynamic zones.
214
215        Args:
216            update_static_zones (bool, optional):
217                Whether to update static zones. Defaults to ``False``.
218            update_dynamic_zones (bool, optional):
219                Whether to update dynamic zones. Defaults to ``False``.
220            clear_grid (bool, optional):
221                If ``True``, regenerate empty grids before updating.
222                Defaults to ``False``.
223        """
224        if clear_grid:
225            self.static_grid = self.__generate_base_grid()
226            self.static_and_dynamic_grid = self.__generate_base_grid()
227
228        # 1. Update all not updated forbidden zones, based on the update flags
229        # 1.1 Update static zones
230        if update_static_zones:
231            for zone_to_update in self.not_updated_forbidden_zones:
232                # 1.1.1 Update static grid
233                self.static_grid = self.__mark_zone(
234                    grid=self.static_grid,
235                    polygon_to_mark=zone_to_update,
236                    walkable=zone_to_update not in self.static_forbidden_zones,
237                )
238                # 1.1.2 Also update the static_and_dynamic grid
239                #       (only static part of the grid)
240                self.static_and_dynamic_grid = self.__mark_zone(
241                    grid=self.static_and_dynamic_grid,
242                    polygon_to_mark=zone_to_update,
243                    walkable=zone_to_update not in self.static_forbidden_zones,
244                )
245
246        # 1.2 Update dynamic zones
247        if update_dynamic_zones:
248            # 1.2.1 Clear all dynamic zones (get deep copy of static grid)
249            self.static_and_dynamic_grid = copy.deepcopy(self.static_grid)
250
251            # 1.2.2 Then mark the new dynamic zone as forbidden
252            for zone_to_update in self.not_updated_forbidden_zones:
253                self.static_and_dynamic_grid = self.__mark_zone(
254                    grid=self.static_and_dynamic_grid,
255                    polygon_to_mark=zone_to_update,
256                    walkable=False,  # Dynamic zone are always forbidden
257                )
258
259        self.not_updated_forbidden_zones: list[Polygon] = []
260
261    # ====== Public Methods ======
262    @override
263    def __eq__(self, other: object) -> bool:
264        if not isinstance(other, GridManager):
265            return False
266
267        def grid_to_numpy(grid: Grid) -> np.ndarray[Any, np.dtype[np.bool_]]:
268            return np.array(
269                [
270                    [1 if node.walkable else 0 for node in row]
271                    for row in cast("list[list[GridNode]]", grid.nodes)
272                ],
273                dtype=bool,
274            )
275
276        return (
277            self.chunk_size == other.chunk_size
278            and self.absolute_width == other.absolute_width
279            and self.absolute_height == other.absolute_height
280            and self.grid_width == other.grid_width
281            and self.grid_height == other.grid_height
282            and self.forbidden_cover_threshold == other.forbidden_cover_threshold
283            and self.static_forbidden_zones == other.static_forbidden_zones
284            and self.not_updated_forbidden_zones == other.not_updated_forbidden_zones
285            and np.array_equal(
286                grid_to_numpy(self.static_grid),
287                grid_to_numpy(other.static_grid),
288            )
289            and np.array_equal(
290                grid_to_numpy(self.static_and_dynamic_grid),
291                grid_to_numpy(other.static_and_dynamic_grid),
292            )
293        )
294
295    @override
296    def __ne__(self, other: object) -> bool:
297        return not self.__eq__(other)
298
299    @override
300    def __hash__(self) -> int:
301        """Return a hash based on grid dimensions and chunk size.
302
303        Returns:
304            int: Hash value representing the grid state.
305        """
306        return hash(
307            (
308                self.chunk_size,
309                self.absolute_width,
310                self.absolute_height,
311                self.grid_width,
312                self.grid_height,
313            ),
314        )
315
316    @time_tracker(lambda self: self.logger)
317    def add_forbidden_static_zone(
318        self,
319        forbidden_zones: Polygon | list[Polygon],
320    ) -> None:
321        """Add static forbidden zones to the grid.
322
323        Args:
324            forbidden_zones (Polygon | list[Polygon]):
325                Zones to mark as static forbidden areas.
326        """
327        if not isinstance(forbidden_zones, list):
328            forbidden_zones = [forbidden_zones]
329
330        self.static_forbidden_zones.extend(forbidden_zones)
331        self.not_updated_forbidden_zones.extend(forbidden_zones)
332        self.__update_grid(update_static_zones=True)
333
334    @time_tracker(lambda self: self.logger)
335    def remove_forbidden_static_zone(
336        self,
337        forbidden_zones_to_remove: Polygon | list[Polygon],
338    ) -> None:
339        """Remove static forbidden zones from the grid.
340
341        Args:
342            forbidden_zones_to_remove (Polygon | list[Polygon]):
343                Zones to remove from static forbidden areas.
344        """
345        if not isinstance(forbidden_zones_to_remove, list):
346            forbidden_zones_to_remove = [forbidden_zones_to_remove]
347
348        original_static_forbidden_zones = self.static_forbidden_zones[:]
349        self.static_forbidden_zones = [
350            zone
351            for zone in self.static_forbidden_zones
352            if zone not in forbidden_zones_to_remove
353        ]
354
355        removed_zones = set(original_static_forbidden_zones) - set(
356            self.static_forbidden_zones,
357        )
358        if not removed_zones:
359            self.logger.log(
360                "Call remove zone but no zone removed. Check if you use buffer.",
361                LogLevels.WARNING,
362            )
363
364        self.not_updated_forbidden_zones.extend(forbidden_zones_to_remove)
365        self.__update_grid(update_static_zones=True)
366
367    @time_tracker(lambda self: self.logger)
368    def update_dynamic_forbidden_zones(self, forbidden_zones: list[Polygon]) -> None:
369        """Updates dynamic forbidden zones in the grid.
370
371        Args:
372            forbidden_zones (list[Polygon]): Dynamic zones to add or update.
373        """
374        if not isinstance(forbidden_zones, list):
375            forbidden_zones = [forbidden_zones]
376
377        self.not_updated_forbidden_zones.extend(forbidden_zones)
378        self.__update_grid(update_dynamic_zones=True)
379
380    def get_grid_node_center(self, node: GridNode) -> tuple[float, float]:
381        """Calculate the absolute center coordinates of a grid node.
382
383        Args:
384            node (GridNode): Node within the grid.
385
386        Returns:
387            tuple[float, float]: ``(x, y)`` coordinates of the node center.
388        """
389        return (
390            node.x * self.chunk_size + self.half_chunk_size,
391            node.y * self.chunk_size + self.half_chunk_size,
392        )
393
394    def absolute_coords_to_grid_coords(self, point: OrientedPoint | Point) -> GridNode:
395        """Convert absolute coordinates to grid coordinates.
396
397        Args:
398            point (OrientedPoint | Point): Absolute point to convert.
399
400        Returns:
401            GridNode: Corresponding node in the grid.
402        """
403        return GridNode(int(point.x / self.chunk_size), int(point.y / self.chunk_size))
404
405    def grid_coords_to_absolute_coords(self, node: GridNode) -> Point:
406        """Convert grid coordinates to absolute coordinates.
407
408        Args:
409            node (GridNode): Grid node to convert.
410
411        Returns:
412            Point: Absolute center point of the node.
413        """
414        x, y = self.get_grid_node_center(node)
415        return Point(x, y)
416
417    def get_static_grid(self) -> Grid:
418        """Return the static grid used for pathfinding.
419
420        Returns:
421            Grid: Grid containing only static obstacles.
422        """
423        return self.static_grid
424
425    def get_static_and_dynamic_grid(self) -> Grid:
426        """Return the grid with both static and dynamic obstacles.
427
428        Returns:
429            Grid: Combined grid.
430        """
431        return self.static_and_dynamic_grid
432
433    def visualize(
434        self,
435        *,
436        only_static_grid: bool = False,
437        path: list | None = None,
438        show: bool = True,
439        plot: tuple[plt.Axes, pltFigure] | None = None,
440    ) -> tuple[plt.Axes, pltFigure]:
441        """Visualize the grid using matplotlib.
442
443        Args:
444            only_static_grid (bool, optional):
445                Whether to show only the static grid. Defaults to ``False``.
446            path (list | None, optional):
447                Path to draw on the grid, if provided. Defaults to None.
448            show (bool, optional):
449                Whether to display the plot. Defaults to ``True``.
450            plot (tuple[plt.Axes, pltFigure] | None, optional):
451                Existing plot to reuse. Defaults to None.
452
453        Returns:
454            tuple[plt.Axes, pltFigure]: Axis and figure of the plot.
455        """
456        grid_to_visualize = (
457            self.static_grid if only_static_grid else self.static_and_dynamic_grid
458        )
459
460        if plot:
461            ax, fig = plot
462        else:
463            fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 6))
464
465        for y in range(self.grid_height):
466            for x in range(self.grid_width):
467                if not grid_to_visualize.node(x, y).walkable:
468                    ax.add_patch(pltRectangle((x, y), 1, 1, color="black"))
469
470        if path:
471            for i in range(len(path) - 1):
472                # Draw a line connecting the current node to the next node
473                ax.plot(
474                    [path[i].x, path[i + 1].x],
475                    [path[i].y, path[i + 1].y],
476                    color="purple",
477                    linewidth=1,
478                    alpha=0.2,
479                )
480
481        ax.set_xticks(range(self.grid_width))
482        ax.set_yticks(range(self.grid_height))
483
484        ax.set_xlim(self.grid_width, 0)
485        ax.set_ylim(0, self.grid_height)
486
487        ax.xaxis.set_major_locator(MaxNLocator(integer=True, nbins=25))
488        ax.yaxis.set_major_locator(MaxNLocator(integer=True, nbins=25))
489        plt.xticks(rotation=45)
490
491        ax.set_aspect("equal", adjustable="box")
492        ax.set_title("Arena Grid Visualization")
493
494        ax.grid(visible=True)
495        plt.tight_layout()
496        if show:
497            plt.show()
498
499        return ax, fig

Manages a grid for pathfinding and collision detection.

Includes static and dynamic forbidden zones and grid visualization.

  • The grid uses a coordinate system where the origin is in the bottom-right corner.
  • X-axis increases towards the left, while Y-axis increases upwards.
  • This reference frame affects calculations and visualization; adjustments ensure alignment.

def visualize( self, *, only_static_grid: bool = False, path: list | None = None, show: bool = True, plot: tuple[matplotlib.axes._axes.Axes, matplotlib.figure.Figure] | None = None) -> tuple[matplotlib.axes._axes.Axes, matplotlib.figure.Figure]: 
433    def visualize(
434        self,
435        *,
436        only_static_grid: bool = False,
437        path: list | None = None,
438        show: bool = True,
439        plot: tuple[plt.Axes, pltFigure] | None = None,
440    ) -> tuple[plt.Axes, pltFigure]:
441        """Visualize the grid using matplotlib.
442
443        Args:
444            only_static_grid (bool, optional):
445                Whether to show only the static grid. Defaults to ``False``.
446            path (list | None, optional):
447                Path to draw on the grid, if provided. Defaults to None.
448            show (bool, optional):
449                Whether to display the plot. Defaults to ``True``.
450            plot (tuple[plt.Axes, pltFigure] | None, optional):
451                Existing plot to reuse. Defaults to None.
452
453        Returns:
454            tuple[plt.Axes, pltFigure]: Axis and figure of the plot.
455        """
456        grid_to_visualize = (
457            self.static_grid if only_static_grid else self.static_and_dynamic_grid
458        )
459
460        if plot:
461            ax, fig = plot
462        else:
463            fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 6))
464
465        for y in range(self.grid_height):
466            for x in range(self.grid_width):
467                if not grid_to_visualize.node(x, y).walkable:
468                    ax.add_patch(pltRectangle((x, y), 1, 1, color="black"))
469
470        if path:
471            for i in range(len(path) - 1):
472                # Draw a line connecting the current node to the next node
473                ax.plot(
474                    [path[i].x, path[i + 1].x],
475                    [path[i].y, path[i + 1].y],
476                    color="purple",
477                    linewidth=1,
478                    alpha=0.2,
479                )
480
481        ax.set_xticks(range(self.grid_width))
482        ax.set_yticks(range(self.grid_height))
483
484        ax.set_xlim(self.grid_width, 0)
485        ax.set_ylim(0, self.grid_height)
486
487        ax.xaxis.set_major_locator(MaxNLocator(integer=True, nbins=25))
488        ax.yaxis.set_major_locator(MaxNLocator(integer=True, nbins=25))
489        plt.xticks(rotation=45)
490
491        ax.set_aspect("equal", adjustable="box")
492        ax.set_title("Arena Grid Visualization")
493
494        ax.grid(visible=True)
495        plt.tight_layout()
496        if show:
497            plt.show()
498
499        return ax, fig

445    @override
446    def __eq__(self, other: object) -> bool:
447        """Checks equality between two ShowArena instances.
448
449        Args:
450            other (object): The other instance to compare against.
451
452        Returns:
453            bool: ``True`` if the instances are equal, ``False`` otherwise.
454        """
455        if not isinstance(other, ShowArena):
456            return False
457
458        return (
459            self.ally_zone == other.ally_zone
460            and self.enemy_zone == other.enemy_zone
461            and self.grid_manager == other.grid_manager
462        )
463
464    @override
465    def __ne__(self, other: object) -> bool:
466        return not self.__eq__(other)
467
468    @override
469    def __hash__(self) -> int:
470        return hash((
471            self.ally_zone,
472            self.enemy_zone,
473            self.grid_manager,
474        ))

265                        -pi / 2,
266                    ),
267                ],
268            ),
269            (
270                (255, 65),
271                (300, 110),
272                [
273                    OrientedPoint(
274                        277.5,
275                        65 - distance_between_robot_and_big_construct_zone,
276                        pi / 2,
277                    ),
278                    OrientedPoint(
279                        277.5,
280                        110 + distance_between_robot_and_big_construct_zone,
281                        -pi / 2,
282                    ),
283                    OrientedPoint(
284                        255 - distance_between_robot_and_big_construct_zone,
285                        87.5,
286                        0,
287                    ),
288                ],
289            ),
290            (
291                (100, 0),
292                (145, 45),
293                [
294                    OrientedPoint(
295                        122.5,
296                        45 + distance_between_robot_and_big_construct_zone,
297                        -pi / 2,
298                    ),
299                ],
300            ),
301            (
302                (55, 0),
303                (100, 15),
304                [
305                    OrientedPoint(
306                        77.5,
307                        15 + distance_between_robot_and_small_construct_zone,
308                        -pi / 2,
309                    ),
310                ],
311            ),
312        ]
313
314        forbidden_zones_points: list[
315            tuple[tuple[float, float], tuple[float, float]]
316        ] = []
317
318        zones: list[BaseArenaZone] = []
319
320        zones.extend(
321            StuffZone(
322                logger=stuff_zone_logger,
323                buffer_size=obstacle_buffer,
324                polygon=create_straight_rectangle(
325                    Point(*corner_point[0]),
326                    Point(*corner_point[1]),
327                ),
328                go_to_positions=(
329                    corner_point[GO_TO_POSITIONS_INDEX]
330                    if len(corner_point) > GO_TO_POSITIONS_INDEX
331                    else None
332                ),
333            )
334            for corner_point in stuff_zones_points
335        )
336
337        zones.extend(
338            YellowReservedZone(
339                logger=yellow_reserved_zone_logger,
340                buffer_size=obstacle_buffer,
341                polygon=create_straight_rectangle(
342                    Point(*corner_point[0]),
343                    Point(*corner_point[1]),
344                ),
345                go_to_positions=(
346                    corner_point[GO_TO_POSITIONS_INDEX]
347                    if len(corner_point) > GO_TO_POSITIONS_INDEX
348                    else None
349                ),
350            )
351            for corner_point in yellow_reserved_zones_points
352        )
353
354        zones.extend(
355            BlueReservedZone(
356                logger=blue_reserved_zone_logger,
357                buffer_size=obstacle_buffer,
358                polygon=create_straight_rectangle(
359                    Point(*corner_point[0]),
360                    Point(*corner_point[1]),
361                ),
362                go_to_positions=(
363                    corner_point[GO_TO_POSITIONS_INDEX]
364                    if len(corner_point) > GO_TO_POSITIONS_INDEX
365                    else None
366                ),
367            )
368            for corner_point in blue_reserved_zones_points
369        )
370
371        zones.extend(
372            ForbiddenZone(
373                logger=forbidden_zone_logger,
374                buffer_size=obstacle_buffer,
375                polygon=create_straight_rectangle(
376                    Point(*corner_point[0]),
377                    Point(*corner_point[1]),
378                ),
379            )
380            for corner_point in forbidden_zones_points
381        )
382
383        # This is the scene for the rockstar
384        rockstar_stage = ForbiddenZone(
385            logger=forbidden_zone_logger,
386            buffer_size=obstacle_buffer,
387            polygon=Polygon(
388                (
389                    (65, 200),
390                    (65, 180),
391                    (105, 180),
392                    (105, 155),
393                    (195, 155),
394                    (195, 180),
395                    (235, 180),
396                    (235, 200),
397                    (65, 200),
398                ),
399            ),
400        )
401
402        zones.extend((
403            rockstar_stage,
404            BlueReservedZone(
405                logger=blue_reserved_zone_logger,
406                buffer_size=obstacle_buffer,
407                polygon=create_straight_rectangle(Point((15, 155)), Point((60, 200))),
408                go_to_positions=[OrientedPoint(37.5, 150.5, pi / 2)],
409            ),
410            YellowReservedZone(
411                logger=yellow_reserved_zone_logger,
412                buffer_size=obstacle_buffer,
413                polygon=create_straight_rectangle(Point((285, 155)), Point((240, 200))),
414                go_to_positions=[OrientedPoint(262.5, 150.5, pi / 2)],
415            ),
416        ))
417
418        if grid_manager_logger:
419            super().__init__(
420                logger,
421                width=300,
422                height=200,
423                border_buffer=border_buffer,
424                obstacle_buffer=obstacle_buffer,
425                zones=zones,
426                chunk_size=chunk_size,
427                forbidden_cover_threshold=forbidden_cover_threshold,
428                grid_manager_logger=grid_manager_logger,
429            )
430        else:
431            super().__init__(
432                logger,
433                width=300,
434                height=200,
435                border_buffer=border_buffer,
436                obstacle_buffer=obstacle_buffer,
437                zones=zones,
438                chunk_size=chunk_size,
439                forbidden_cover_threshold=forbidden_cover_threshold,
440            )
441
442        self.logger.info("ShowArena initialized.")
443        self.logger.debug(f"Width: {self.width}, Height: {self.height}")

class StuffZone(arena.BaseArenaZone): 
 20class StuffZone(BaseArenaZone):
 21    """Zone designated for storage or placement of items."""
 22
 23    def __init__(
 24        self,
 25        logger: Logger,
 26        buffer_size: float = 0.0,
 27        polygon: Polygon | None = None,
 28        buffered_polygon: Polygon | None = None,
 29        update_callback: Callable | None = None,
 30        go_to_positions: list[OrientedPoint | Point] | None = None,
 31    ) -> None:
 32        """Initializes the StuffZone with geometry, buffer, and accessibility.
 33
 34        Args:
 35            logger (Logger): Logger instance for logging messages.
 36            buffer_size (float, optional):
 37                Buffer size for geometric adjustments. Defaults to 0.0.
 38            polygon (Polygon | None, optional):
 39                Polygon representing the zone geometry. Defaults to None.
 40            buffered_polygon (Polygon | None, optional):
 41                Buffered polygon geometry. Defaults to None.
 42            update_callback (Callable | None, optional):
 43                Function to be called on updates. Defaults to None.
 44            go_to_positions (list[OrientedPoint | Point] | None, optional):
 45                List of go-to positions within the zone. Defaults to None.
 46        """
 47        super().__init__(
 48            logger=logger,
 49            zone_type=ZoneType.STUFF_ZONE,
 50            accessibility=ZoneAccessibility.RESTRICTED,
 51            buffer_size=buffer_size,
 52            polygon=polygon,
 53            buffered_polygon=buffered_polygon,
 54            update_callback=update_callback,
 55            zone_color="#0FEE9C",
 56            go_to_positions=go_to_positions,
 57        )
 58
 59    @override
 60    def update(
 61        self,
 62        team_color: TeamColor,
 63        ally_position: Point | OrientedPoint,
 64        enemy_position: Point | OrientedPoint,
 65    ) -> None:
 66        """Updates the zone accessibility based on the positions of allies and enemies.
 67
 68        Args:
 69            team_color (TeamColor): The color of the team.
 70            ally_position (Point | OrientedPoint): Position of an ally.
 71            enemy_position (Point | OrientedPoint): Position of an enemy.
 72        """
 73        super().update(team_color, ally_position, enemy_position)
 74
 75        # Update accessibility to free if an ally or enemy is within the zone
 76        if (
 77            self.buffered_polygon.contains(ally_position)
 78            or self.buffered_polygon.contains(enemy_position)
 79        ) and self.accessibility != ZoneAccessibility.FREE:
 80            self._make_accessible()
 81
 82    @override
 83    def get_go_to_position(
 84        self,
 85        ally_position: OrientedPoint,
 86        team_color: TeamColor,
 87    ) -> OrientedPoint | Point | None:
 88        """Determine the best go-to position for an ally in the given zone.
 89
 90        Args:
 91            ally_position (OrientedPoint): Position of the ally.
 92            team_color (TeamColor): Color of the team.
 93
 94        Returns:
 95            OrientedPoint | Point | None:
 96                Best go-to position, or ``None`` if inaccessible.
 97        """
 98        if self.accessibility == ZoneAccessibility.FORBIDDEN:
 99            self.logger.debug(
100                f"GoTo position request: Zone {self.zone_type} is not accessible.",
101            )
102            return None
103
104        # If no specific go-to positions are defined, return the centroid of the zone
105        if not self.go_to_positions:
106            self.logger.debug(
107                "GoTo position request: "
108                f"No defined go-to positions for zone {self.zone_type}, "
109                f"returning centroid [{self.polygon.centroid}]",
110            )
111            return self.polygon.centroid
112
113        nearest_position = min(
114            self.go_to_positions,
115            key=ally_position.distance,
116        )
117        msg = (
118            "GoTo position request: Nearest go-to position to ally "
119            f"[{ally_position}] is [{nearest_position}]"
120        )
121        self.logger.debug(msg)
122
123        return nearest_position
